description: This file defines the RoleService class for managing roles, including CRUD operations, validation, and database interactions within a TypeScript project using TypeORM.

classes.name: RoleService
classes.description: Service class for handling role-related operations such as creation, reading, updating, and deletion of roles, with validation and database transaction management.

methods.name: validateRoleId
methods.description: Validates that the provided role ID is a valid UUID.

methods.name: readRoleById
methods.description: Fetches a role by its ID using a QueryRunner.

methods.name: validateRoleName
methods.description: Validates that the role name is valid.

methods.name: readRoleByOrganizationId
methods.description: Retrieves roles associated with a specific organization, including user counts.

methods.name: readRoleByRoleIdOrganizationId
methods.description: Fetches a role by its ID and organization ID.

methods.name: readGeneralRoleByName
methods.description: Retrieves a general (organizationId null) role by name.

methods.name: readRoleIsGeneral
methods.description: Checks if a role is a general role (organizationId null) by ID.

methods.name: saveRole
methods.description: Saves a role entity to the database.

methods.name: createRole
methods.description: Creates a new role with validation and transaction management.

methods.name: updateRole
methods.description: Updates an existing role with validation and transaction management.

methods.name: deleteRole
methods.description: Deletes a role and associated workspace users within a transaction.
